notes: Infrastructure + exoneration case. The San Pedro Bay Pipeline (operator Amplify Energy / Beta Offshore) began leaking the evening of 1 Oct 2021, 4.75 nm off Huntington Beach (NTSB casualty location 33°34.20' N, 118°7.26' W); first leak alarm 1 Oct 16:10 PDT (23:10Z), final shutdown 2 Oct 06:04 PDT. This S1A pass is ~2.8 h after the first alarm, oil still leaking. NTSB MIR-24-01 attributes the cause to the containerships MSC DANIT and Beijing dragging anchor and striking the pipeline on 25 Jan 2021 — 8 months before the release. The pre-run expectation was an origin on the pipeline right-of-way. Measured 14 Sept: the origin-grid peak sits ~6.7 km from NTSB's casualty location, which lies outside the grid, so the declared pipeline scores below the infrastructure floor (D38).Stage 3 abstains on vessels here (top two cannot be separated on this evidence); verify is added only once the infrastructure finding and the hand-written assessment land. D35 seed: trace seeded from det-01 (merged: no, the only oil feature); n_oil=1; seed area 2.64 of 2.64 km2 of oil on the scene. One trace per spill event; selecting another detection does not re-trace.
